'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mike Richards LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

Typed GEMP printout (not a handwritten Xerox form). Page 13 continues the starting cards. The printout totals 59 cards in the Reserve Deck.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
